content.short: DIA is a multi-chain, end-to-end, open-source data and oracle platform for Web3.
content.description: DIA (Decentralised Information Asset) is a cross-chain, end-to-end, open-source data and oracle platform for Web3. It enables developers to source and verify data from both traditional financial systems and digital markets, providing a clear path from raw information to on-chain use. DIA's data feeds cover asset prices, metaverse data, lending rates, and a wide range of other information, all accessible through a single, unified interface to support decentralized finance and smart contract applications.

resources.title: DIA ZK: Verifiable Offchain Data, Proven Onchain
resources.tldr: Uses zkTLS to prove a value genuinely came from a named source, with selective disclosure so the whole response need not be published. Aimed at reserves, NAV and collateral attestation.

resources.title: How ST0x Uses DIA Oracles for Tokenized Equity Trading
resources.tldr: Intent-based order logic on tokenised equities lives or dies on price freshness. A concrete look at what an oracle has to guarantee before that design is safe to run.
